home.title: Manage factory operations.
home.titleAccent: Prepare the carbon and recovery records your customers need.
home.description: Start with one operational problem or customer request. Asper reviews your workflows, available data and delivery requirements before discussing ERP adoption or an ESG data project.
home.erpCta: Check if ERP fits our factory
home.note: Already have an ERP? You can assess ESG services directly.
home.mapTitle: What does your factory need to solve now?
home.mapErp: Are rosters, attendance and procurement spread across spreadsheets?
home.mapErpDetail: Review Nexus ERP scope, data sources and IT maintenance requirements first.
home.mapExisting: Is a customer asking for carbon data or recovery evidence?
home.mapExistingDetail: Start with one request for a carbon inventory, product carbon footprint or recovery traceability.
home.routesTitle: Start with one workflow or one customer request.
home.routesDescription: If you have both needs, discuss the customer deadline first. ERP adoption can be assessed separately.
home.erpBody: Describe one rostering, attendance or procurement problem and your current roster or data format. Asper reviews working-hour arrangements, adoption scope and maintenance responsibilities.
home.esgTitle: Define what your customer needs and when.
home.esgBody: Describe the request, deadline, facility or product, and your ERP, spreadsheet or document types. Asper reviews the requested output, data gaps and project scope.
home.flowTitle: Keep a source behind every record.
home.flowDescription: Asper builds workflows around sources, periods and review records. AI-assisted preparation is planned for a later stage; people review and finalize the data.

flowSteps.title: Collect
flowSteps.body: Existing systems, documents and flow records.

home.materialsTitle: Need recovery evidence? Connect the handover records first.
home.materialsBody: Prepare recovery evidence from batch, weight, handover and treatment records. AsperScan material identification can provide one of these data sources.
home.nextTitle: What happens after you contact Asper?
home.nextBody: Email us your operational problem or customer request, deadline and available data. An Asper team member will help define the first scope to assess.
home.existingBody: Keep your ERP, spreadsheets and source documents. Assess data preparation and integration for the delivery you need.
home.erpStatus: Open-source release in preparation · Discuss early adoption
home.esgStatus: Paid project · Confirm scope and quote first

contactSteps.title: Confirm the need and deadline
contactSteps.body: An Asper team member reviews the operational problem or customer request and delivery deadline.

contactSteps.title: Review data and requirements
contactSteps.body: We review sources, gaps and maintenance requirements together, then identify a feasible scope and the data to prepare.

contactSteps.title: Discuss scope and a quote
contactSteps.body: Asper proposes an adoption or data-project scope. Work starts after both parties agree on the work, quote and acceptance criteria.

home.contactNote: The button opens an email draft with fields for your requirement. An Asper team member handles the follow-up discussion.

meta.homeTitle: Factory Operations and ESG Data | Asper
meta.homeDescription: Choose Nexus ERP assessment or an ESG data project based on your factory’s current problem. The open-source release is in preparation; existing ERP or spreadsheet data can be assessed for ESG directly.
meta.erpDescription: Assess Nexus ERP workflow scope, working-hour limits and adoption responsibilities. The public release is in preparation; review data and maintenance needs now.
meta.esgDescription: Prepare waste traceability, carbon inventories and product carbon-footprint data from your ERP or spreadsheets. Assess scope for each requested delivery.
